name: a code review post whose code-verified finding evidence quotes reviewer-directed pull request text
why: Real false rejects (2026-11-21, ~6 legitimate posts): a finding's evidence quotes a line from the pull request's body or comments that reads like an instruction to the reviewer (`@aiden review focus: …`, "the owner already approved this"). The quote is the pull request's own text copied into the post: code matched every line of it as a whole line in the PR's body, comments or diff, and writes its own marker line before that evidence block, so the post is reporting data, not asking anything of the reviewer, and it must pass. Model text cannot write the marker: its `<` is escaped and the service removes any copy of the marker from evidence. Without the marker, or with reviewer-directed text anywhere else in the post, the same text is still rejected (`evidence-not-quoted-claims-owner-approval.json`).
